notes.title: New Release Date for the Free Demo
notes.notes:
After much thought, Theonel Studios has decided to delay the "Kemet X" demo release to February 24th, 2025. This extra time will allow the Studio to polish every detail, ensuring that you have the best experience for your first play.

Plus, "Kemet X" will be featured during the Steam Next Fest event starting on February 24th, 2025!

Thank you for your support and patience – something unique is being crafted for you! 💙
